item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the winter monsoon, the weather will still be relatively cold and windy over the coast of southern China during the Lunar New Year holidays. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the region. A replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will improve with cold mornings over the region. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 01/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Misty at first. Cold in the morning.
Temp range: 12 - 15 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
